cases.name: Hadley v. Baxendale
cases.summary: English Exchequer decision illustrating foreseeability limits on consequential contract damages; historical persuasive reference, not automatically binding in a United States jurisdiction.
cases.relevance: Consequential damages; foreseeability; evidence of unusual loss and notice to the parties.

cases.name: Lucy v. Zehmer
cases.summary: Virginia Supreme Court decision examining outward manifestations of assent even when a party claims a private intent to joke; binding status depends on the relevant jurisdiction and later treatment.
cases.relevance: Objective assent; offer and acceptance; contract formation; evidentiary dispute over intent.

statutes.name: Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act
statutes.summary: Federal electronic-record and signature validity provision for qualifying interstate or foreign commerce transactions; the statute contains exceptions and does not eliminate other formation or enforceability rules.

statutes.name: Federal Arbitration Act — arbitration agreements
statutes.summary: Federal provision governing qualifying written arbitration agreements involving maritime or commercial transactions; application depends on coverage, defenses, later amendments, and statutory exceptions.
